# Trippinity

> Trippinity is a travel marketplace to discover curated group and solo-friendly trips from verified local planners across India, with transparent pricing, day-wise itineraries, and 25% upfront booking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Trippinity — curated trips, verified planners, booking flow.
- [Explore trips](/explore): Search and filter curated trips by destination, price, duration, and rating.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Browse trips by destination across India.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Traveller stories and reviews.
- [About](/about): How Trippinity works and who we are.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch for questions and partnerships.
- [Terms & Privacy](/terms-and-privacy): Terms of service and privacy policy.
